svg.title: A smart home, from sensor to phone
svg.desc:
A smart home, from sensor to phone States shown: Live, Being built, In trial, Retiring. Solid lines: data flows today. Dotted lines: connection to build.
Blocks, left to right: - Devices (In every room): Thermostat; Door lock; Lights; Motion sensors - Home hub (Talks to every device): Device pairing; Local rules; Works offline (being built) - Cloud: Device registry; Usage history; Firmware updates (being built). Owner: Platform team - Apps: Phone app; Voice assistants (in trial); Web dashboard (retiring). Owner: Apps team Lines: - Devices -> Home hub - Home hub -> Cloud - Cloud -> Apps - Apps -> Home hub, labeled "At home, the phone talks to the hub directly" - Cloud -> Devices (connection to build), labeled "New firmware sent to devices at night" Note: Example. An invented product. Every part and status is made up.
